title: Page 77
transc:
R OBrien Gen Butler Hd Qrs Washn 1215 pm May 23d 1864
Viola harrow perfume for Palate Meigs & Palsy Barnard tulip
John has moved waxend to mill ford station & changed
his base of supplies to Flint zodiac He says Hunter
spencer by Pickets quincy & other whinny from Galway &
that Knox saint is not detaining federal purple torch rome
tulip your white anxiously looked for zebra water wherry for
whiff to the Amen should be prepared youth Indian all


R. R. McCaine  Wash'n May 23rd 9. pm 1864 
Genrl Rosalie Harsh Perfume For Mackerel Unity There
are no vacant says of Palsy of Wilcox
zebra You have Pebble Shelbys of Pacific in
your Quadrant Pekin Stall Duffin and Dover Pedlar
certainly Enough for your Panama Salem zodiac If
any are worth less recon mend to 
be mustered out and I will endorse it
unity No Plug can be appointed till some
Plunge Else is mustered out yoke Jacob up
